# Conflict Rule 1 ## Follow conflict terms.
## General conflict terms.
- Any conflict is allowed with a [color=red][bold]proper, reasonable RP reason[/bold][/color]. A stolen magazine may be a reason for a fistfight, but not a meatgrinder. -- Conflict reason has to correlate with punishment. Killing someone and then reviving them right after for insulting you is fine, but its totally not a reason to gib them. -- Respawning after death caused by conflict will result into [color=yellow]15-minute grace period[/color] before being able to initiate combat again with same group by yourself.
- Individual-To-Individual conflict has a [color=yellow]long-lasting effect[/color], meaning that you can [color=red][bold]immediately[/bold][/color] escalate into combat based on previous events. -- [color=red]Events from previous rounds [bold]do not[/bold] apply.[/color] -- This does not apply to outposts, meaning that you [color=red][bold]can't[/bold][/color] portstrike outpost based on previous events. For any exceptions - refer to ConR4. -- Respawning after death caused by conflict [color=yellow][bold]resets[/bold][/color] conflict's long-lasting effect for both parties.
- Escalation with empty outposts or SSD players is [color=red][bold]prohibited[/bold][/color]. -- You can still engage empty outposts or SSD players if properly escalated [color=yellow]before[/color] they gone offline.
- Escalation to combat immediately is allowed in select circumstances such as cases of [color=red]confirmed pirates, hostile vessels[/color] [color=yellow]chimera/ADC[/color], etc. -- Vessel crew is allowed to [color=red][bold]KOS[/bold][/color] anyone who hacks or breaks their locked doors under "Castle doctrine."
###Major conflicts.
- [color=yellow]Initiating major conflict will result into immediate combat escalation with majority of factions.[/color] -- General unreasonable hostility towards neutral factions/civilians, destruction of neutral outposts or releasing bioweapon results into major conflict. -- Your ship(s) will be allowed to be [color=red][bold]KOS[/bold][/color], and your outpost (if you have any) will be allowed to be portstriked.
###ACEZ (Active Combat Engagement Zone).
- [color=yellow]ACEZ covers specific zone (Outpost or POI) and 1024m range around it. Anyone in the ACEZ can [color=red][bold]instantly[/bold][/color] escalate into combat with anyone.[/color] - Points Of Interest (e.g., Derelict Drillsite, Sevastopol, etc.) with [bold][color=red]Confirmed[/color][/bold] NFZ (No Fly Zone) or ongoing battles are classified as ACEZ (Active Combat Engagement Zone) -- [color=red]This does not include battles with initially antagonistic vessels/people (e.g., Chimera, ADS).[/color] -- Outposts that are getting portstriked also count as ACEZ.
## Group conflict terms.
- Major factions (TSF/PDV) are [color=green]allowed[/color] to immediately escalate into combat with eachother. - Faction(s) civilians count as neutral group(s), requiring you to properly escalate with them. -- However, if faction civilian happens to wear [color=orange]faction's combat gear or use any combat ship[/color] - you are allowed to immediately escalate into combat with them as opposing faction. -- Faction civilian that [color=orange]actively[/color] assists faction members (Healing them in front of you, etc.) are also allowed to be instantly escalated with.
- Any groups that are in active war are [color=green]allowed[/color] to immediately escalate into combat with eachother. -- War can be declared by one group on another if there is proper RP reasoning behind it.
